status: new research specification fixed before outcome computation; not historical preregistration
manuscript_basis: v16 Sections 3.3-3.7, not contradictory Appendix A hand-weighted engine

eligibility.duplicate_id_policy: exclude all records in repeated nonempty incident_id groups across eligible source statuses, rather than arbitrarily selecting a record
eligibility.population_label: publicly disclosed target-industry file records; not SME-qualified organizations or confirmed observed ATT&CK techniques

mapping.normalization: active Enterprise IDs; roll up subtechniques to active parent; omit techniques with only reconnaissance/resource-development tactics
mapping.path_credit: 1 / number of unique retained parent techniques for this variety path
mapping.incident_credit: maximum credit across paths for each technique, not a sum
mapping.sector_frequency: sum incident-technique fractional credits divided by number of mapped records
mapping.bootstrap_eligibility: only records retaining at least one technique credit
mapping.coverage: CTID complete mitigates mappings on exact Low control IDs; no enhancement inheritance; same parent normalization as incident mapping
mapping.native_mitigation_supplement: disabled because complete author module-to-mitigation mapping is unspecified and asymmetric supplement would bias the traditional comparison
mapping.missing_mapping_meaning: not represented by this crosswalk, not zero security value or guaranteed residual risk

profiles.preimplemented_order: first distinct module in natural NIST family/control order, with any unmapped taxonomy modules appended by ID
profiles.bootstrap_draws: number of mapped records in the sector pool, with replacement
profiles.employee_count: omitted; no unsupported organizational-size effect is introduced
profiles.resource_effect: metadata only; no effort or scoring multiplier

evaluation.ranking: descending standalone sum of profile technique frequencies; ascending module ID tie break; not marginal-gain greedy
evaluation.weighted_gap_universe: all parent techniques retained in the eligible mapped four-sector corpus; not just Top25
evaluation.top25: descriptive pooled-frequency view only, weights normalized by largest pooled raw credit
evaluation.module_comparison: analytics versus fixed NIST-derived module sequence, equal remaining-module counts; report unequal underlying control counts, no effort interpretation
evaluation.matched_control_comparison: flatten analytics-ordered modules into their NIST controls versus NIST natural control order; equal remaining-control counts and identical preimplemented controls
evaluation.module_without_controls: taxonomy member retained and reported; receives no CTID-derived technique credit
evaluation.in_sample: manuscript-style bootstrap used for both ranking and evaluation; descriptive fit to sampled evidence, not out-of-sample validation
evaluation.held_out_companion: seeded 70/30 per-sector source-ID split; bootstrap training records only, evaluate on fixed held-out sector frequencies; paired summaries are descriptive and share held-out pools

graph.edges: explicit OSCAL related-control links whose endpoints are both in selected Low catalog
report: longest condensation path in components and edges
graph.forbidden_label: largest SCC called a linear chain or implementation sequence

statistics.primary_outputs: descriptive paired gaps, improved/tied/worse counts, all-pair and nonzero medians
statistics.optional_signed_rank: exact two-sided conditional sign-randomization using average tied ranks and drop-zero policy; explicitly differs from unspecified SciPy approximate tie handling
statistics.interpretation: conditional simulation statistic, not inference from 36 independent observed organizations
statistics.hypothesis_acceptance: not automatically determined; provenance and confirmatory chronology remain unresolved

not_implemented_as_evidence: CIS/SOC2 graph or complexity composites from unequal proxies
